messages:
Ella: forwarding customer report — promo code is rejected as invalid/expired but dashboard shows it as active. Account acct_1234, email masked user+trial@example.com. Code shown: SPRINGSAVE50. They tried via web and our API, both returned PROMO_INVALID. Can someone triage? @Mike for billing check, @Laura for eng help.

Mike: on it — can you paste the API request_id and raw response body if you have it? also what time they tried?

Ella: copied from support logs:
```
POST /v1/promos/redeem
{ "account_id": "acct_1234", "code": "SPRINGSAVE50" }
Response 400
{
  "error": { "code": "PROMO_INVALID", "message": "code invalid or expired" },
  "request_id": "req_01GabcDEF",
  "timestamp": "2026-01-25T15:12:03Z"
}
```
I see two POSTs within the same second from the client: 15:12:03Z and 15:12:03Z (ms diff).

Ella: DB row snapshot (redacted): promo.code=SPRINGSAVE50, active=true, redeemed_count=0, max_redemptions=1, expires_at=2026-02-28T23:59:59Z, last_checked_at=2026-01-25T15:12:02Z

Laura: interesting — two quick requests could hit a race in our redemption flow. current flow: read promo from cache -> check redeemed_count -> write increment -> mark cache TTL. If two requests read the same cached value before write completes, second will try to consume and fail depending on final write order. we recently changed cache write-behavior to be eventually consistent to reduce load, which introduced a small window.

Laura: i can reproduce locally with a simple parallel script. repro steps:
```
# run from a shell with API_KEY set
for i in 1 2; do \
  curl -s -X POST $BASE_URL/v1/promos/redeem \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"account_id":"acct_1234","code":"SPRINGSAVE50"}' &
done
wait
# observe one success and one 400 (race) or both 400 depending on timing
```

Mike: customer has been waiting — I'll issue a manual credit now and note it on the account.

BillingBot: [automated] Manual credit of $50 applied to acct_1234 by Mike. Reference CR-9876.

Mike: done. emailed customer confirmation and applied credit.

Laura: proposed fix: acquire short Redis lock (SETNX) keyed on promo:{code}:lock before checking/consuming; hold for up to 5s; after write, release and invalidate cached promo entry immediately. i'll open a hotfix branch P-1234 and push patch + small migration to add metrics for concurrent_redemption_attempts.

Ella: ETA and impact? can we push a hotfix to prod today?

Laura: hotfix PR opened, running CI now. plan: canary deploy to 2 instances, monitor redemption metric and SLOs, then roll to full prod. estimated 2h to hotfix deploy if CI passes. rollback plan is simple (revert commit).

Mike: created internal incident INC-2026-45 to track customer impact and manual credits. assigned to Laura.

OpsBot: deploy started for commit abc123 (P-1234) — canary to prod-1.

OpsBot: deploy succeeded on canary in 8m; tests green.

Laura: hotfix deployed to prod fully. added metric and a short-lived lock implementation. re-tested with parallel script: first request -> 200 success, second -> 409 ALREADY_REDEEMED (new explicit response). logs: request_id req_01Gnew1 succeeded, req_01Gnew2 -> 409.

Ella: I reached out to the customer, asked them to retry. they confirmed afterwards that the promo applied successfully when retried and the manual credit is present.

Mike: marking account note and billing ticket closed. will reconcile the manual credit with finance if needed.

Laura: follow-up actions: 1) ensure lock pattern added for all single-use promos; 2) run a short audit for promos created in last 30 days to find potential conflicts; 3) write a brief postmortem for INC-2026-45.

Ella: thanks all — closing thread. :tada:
